functions.contract: Revalidate request contract. Parse both present raw bodies strictly before maps/structs lose distinctions. Require exact9 response keys, explicit null error/error_code; full read-direction CommandResponse validation including frozen nested refs, date-time formats, RelativePath semantic checks and writeOnly rejection. ACK exact PendingResult, operation_id=op-command; COMPLETED exact CANCEL ControlResult with true settled/children_stopped/queue_empty, target/control_request_id exact original tuple, snapshot.session_id/project_id exact expected relation. New revision >= original expected revision; ACK->final new revision>=old revision. Historical completed replay never calls UPDATE.

Root/member exact principal/project/command/original tuple; complete original VersionRefs; kind-specific fields; genuine NO_RUN null Run/epoch/dispatch and genuine NO_SESSION null generation; QUEUED requires nonnull Run epoch; PREPARED requires original immutable dispatch manifest ref and no process identity; STARTED final requires exact native observation/artifact identity. At ADMITTED there is no unknown future response hash. FINALIZED binds both original/final raw body digests and exact original member refs. Do not claim shape function proves group completeness, cryptographic recomputation of external artifacts or OS/SDK facts. SQL relational guards and producer/current/history validation remain mandatory.

udf_contract.byte_transport: Pinned functionArgs nonvolatile SQLITE_TEXT uses libc.GoString, so embedded NUL can truncate. ALL raw/header/identity text arguments use explicit CAST(original_column AS BLOB) and callback accepts only []byte; native SQL checks original column typeof and exact OLD/NEW bytes separately. BLOB branch copies SQLite exact byte length. Reject string/float/bool/time args; numeric kind must int64. Reject nil unless response old_body explicit initial mode. Do not enable VolatileArgs or unsafe alternative just to avoid this issue.
strict_pipeline: Check argc and exact driver types; original SQL typeof must precede CAST; length byte caps before parse (driver already copied input; SQL outer CASE length gate before callback avoids allocating oversize bodies).

utf8.Valid + canonical.JSON for strict Unicode/duplicates/trailing JSON; domain.Decode for exact numeric preservation. Duplicate escaped names at any nesting rejected before conventional map/struct decoding.
Private header required members/missing-vs-null/unknown key checking, base64 StdEncoding.Strict then exact reencode; validate original raw directly, do not replace stored bytes with normalized bytes.
DecodeEnvelope + SchemaDoc.ValidateDefInput CommandEnvelope and ControlPayload; no schema format drift; positive int64 required, exact integer representation preserved.
Envelope.ContentHash computes the existing custom canonicalBytes algorithm, not JCS Digest. Call actual approved helper; do not substitute a newly computed JCS hash in old request_hash.
Read response JSON strict first, then DecodeResponse + complete ValidateDef CommandResponse and ValidateResultAgainstMethod. JSON null errors mandatory; no secret/writeOnly data in nested responses.

Witness structure validates pure types only. Exact relational group membership, same original Run/epoch, same-tx ledger/queue/process facts validated by SQL predicates and existing trusted producer guards, not callback DB reads.

hash_names.request_hash: Existing Envelope.ContentHash prefix sha256:, immutable stored request semantic identity. Current canonicalBytes sorting/encoding is custom; whitespace equivalent commands may share it.

hash_names.witness_canonical_hash: Digest of RFC8785 canonical.JSON bytes of strict witness only; explicit new versioned format, not reused as old request hash.
hash_names.cross_controls: <>&, Chinese, U+2028/U+2029, nonBMP/BMP ordering, embedded NUL outside JSON versus escaped U+0000, duplicate escaped key names, negative/oversize/non-lossless numbers and missing/null.

No stored fullGoal membership duplication inside every member; reject oversize without partial journal/Run mutations. Response/witness new bound compatibility remains explicit approval item.
